question.question: How do tea/coins/bags enter or leave item tracks, what is track capacity, and can damaged face-up items pay actions?

expected.expected_answer: Face-up tea/coins/bags in Satchel move to empty matching track space when able; each track capacity three. Exhaust track item into Satchel. Damaged items cannot pay actions even if face up; exhaustion requires face-up undamaged item.

source_passages.section: Actions — Vagabond (9), Pawn and items: track movement, capacity and item readiness
source_passages.quotation:
**Pawn and items:** Pawn is not a warrior, cannot rule or block rule, and cannot be removed. An enemy effect removing **all enemy pieces** from its clearing instead damages **three items**. Items may be face up (ready) or face down (exhausted), and independently undamaged or damaged. To exhaust for an action, choose a face-up **undamaged** item and flip it down. Damaged items cannot pay actions.

Face-up tea/coins/bags in Satchel immediately move to empty matching track space if possible; each track holds at most three of its type. Exhausting an item on track sends it to Satchel. Boots/swords/crossbows/torch/hammers are gained face up in Satchel. Damaging an item sends it to Damaged box **without changing its face**. One hit damages one undamaged item of your choice; ignore excess hits when none remain.

answer.part: Tea, coins and bags entering tracks
answer.ruling: Face-up tea, coins and bags in Satchel move immediately to an empty matching track space if possible. Each track can hold at most three of that item type.
Exhausting an item that is on a track sends it to Satchel. Damaging an item sends it to the Damaged box without changing whether it is face up or down.
No. An item must be face up and undamaged to pay for an action; damaged items cannot pay even if they remain face up.
